Hi Pree. In #central-team I found two Marrow Agrisupply sites, both from the 9 Jun 2026 store-rollout thread:

- **Eastbank**: the receiving-door import in ticket PD-4821 labels doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis is handling setup and wants it fixed before anyone reimports. Source: #central-team, 9 Jun 2026.
- **Pine Crossing**: the appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift, so a morning driver was missed. Hollis is checking the shift template. Source: #central-team, 9 Jun 2026, your message.

The channel doesn't name any other stores. The 9 Jun thread is about the new Marrow Agrisupply stores in general, so I've assumed these two are Marrow Agrisupply sites based on that context.

The knowledge base also mentions other sites, but those come from pages outside #central-team, so check them before you rely on them:
- **Enid**: retail distribution yard, in the Central weekly update for 13 Jul 2026 (ticket PD-88309).
- **Kearney**: depot, in the Marrow Agrisupply account page.
- **Salina**: the Salina cross-dock and the Salina store are mentioned in the account page and the Central weekly from Feb 2025. The 2025 MSA meeting notes also mention a Salina yard and Kearney cross-docks, but those notes are about Marrow Fieldworks, so I'm not sure which entity they belong to.

I haven't covered everything: the knowledge search came back truncated, so there may be more sites in other pages. I didn't include any contract or pricing details.
